# ConvoHop SDK documentation

> Reference documentation, quickstarts and tested examples for the ConvoHop SDKs.

Pages are Markdown. Each language has an overview, quickstarts with tested code, a reference for each package and the SDK members that send each API operation. The API operation pages document the GraphQL API that every SDK wraps.

## TypeScript

- [TypeScript SDKs](typescript/index.md): @convohop/server and @convohop/client wrap the ConvoHop API for TypeScript and JavaScript. The server SDK runs in your backend with a secret backend key, and the client SDK runs in your users' apps with a short-lived session for one user. @convohop/react adds React hooks over the client SDK, and @convohop/client/push subscribes browsers to Web Push and shows the notifications.
- [TypeScript server quickstart](typescript/quickstarts/server.md): Call ConvoHop from your Node.js backend with @convohop/server: connect with a backend key, sign in your users, create a conversation, send and read messages as a member, and recover a send whose response was lost.
- [TypeScript client quickstart](typescript/quickstarts/client.md): Use ConvoHop in your users' browsers with @convohop/client: connect with the session your backend issued, show a conversation and keep it current, and send messages that survive dropped connections and page reloads. @convohop/react offers the same as React hooks.
- [TypeScript webhooks quickstart](typescript/quickstarts/webhooks.md): Receive ConvoHop events in your backend with @convohop/server: verify each signed delivery, acknowledge it quickly, and handle its event in a queue worker.
- [TypeScript push notifications quickstart](typescript/quickstarts/push.md): Send push notifications for ConvoHop messages and calls: @convohop/server turns notification events into APNs, FCM and Web Push requests, and you send them with your own push credentials and libraries. In browsers, @convohop/client/push subscribes to Web Push and shows the notifications.
- [TypeScript calling quickstart](typescript/quickstarts/calling.md): Add voice and video calls to a conversation with @convohop/client: start a call and ring other members, join the current call, and leave or end it.
- [TypeScript reference](typescript/reference/index.md): The public API of each TypeScript package, generated from its declarations.
- [@convohop/server](typescript/reference/server.md): Server SDK for trusted Node.js runtimes: backend-key data-plane calls, management, webhook verification and push requests.
- [@convohop/client](typescript/reference/client.md): Client SDK for apps on end-user devices: one signed-in user's conversations, realtime events and calls.
- [@convohop/client/push](typescript/reference/client-push.md): Web Push for browsers and service workers: subscribe a browser, then show and open the notifications your backend sends. It ships with the client SDK.
- [@convohop/react](typescript/reference/react.md): React hooks over the client SDK: conversations with offline-safe sends, typing, session renewal, calls and browser media.
- [TypeScript operation coverage](typescript/reference/operations.md): The TypeScript SDK members that send each API operation. 53 of the 92 operations that TypeScript packages can send have a method.

## Python

- [Python SDK](python/index.md): convohop wraps the ConvoHop API for Python backends, with synchronous and asyncio clients. It runs on your servers with a secret backend key, verifies the webhooks that ConvoHop sends, and builds push requests from notification events.
- [Python server quickstart](python/quickstarts/server.md): Call ConvoHop from your Python backend with convohop: connect with a backend key, sign in your users, create a conversation, send and read messages as a member, recover a send whose response was lost, and do the same from asyncio code.
- [Python webhooks quickstart](python/quickstarts/webhooks.md): Receive ConvoHop events in your Python backend with convohop.webhooks: verify each signed delivery, acknowledge it quickly, and handle its event in a queue worker.
- [Python push notifications quickstart](python/quickstarts/push.md): Send push notifications for ConvoHop messages and calls: convohop.push turns notification events into APNs, FCM and Web Push requests, and you send them with your own push credentials and libraries.
- [Python reference](python/reference/index.md): The public API of each Python package, generated from its declarations.
- [convohop](python/reference/convohop.md): Server SDK for trusted Python backends: sync and async clients for backend-key data-plane calls and management, with typed problems and recovery storage.
- [convohop.webhooks](python/reference/webhooks.md): Verifies Standard Webhooks signatures and parses ConvoHop webhook deliveries into typed events.
- [convohop.push](python/reference/push.md): Builds APNs, FCM and Web Push requests from ConvoHop push notification events.
- [convohop.types](python/reference/types.md): Generated request and response models of the ConvoHop GraphQL API, as frozen dataclasses.
- [Python operation coverage](python/reference/operations.md): The Python SDK members that send each API operation. 63 of the 81 operations that Python packages can send have a method.

## .NET

- [.NET SDK](dotnet/index.md): The ConvoHop package wraps the ConvoHop API for .NET backends. It runs on your servers with a secret backend key, verifies the webhooks that ConvoHop sends, and builds push requests from notification events.
- [.NET server quickstart](dotnet/quickstarts/server.md): Call ConvoHop from your .NET backend with the ConvoHop package: connect with a backend key, sign in your users, create a conversation, send and read messages as a member, and recover a send whose response was lost.
- [.NET webhooks quickstart](dotnet/quickstarts/webhooks.md): Receive ConvoHop events in your .NET backend: verify each signed delivery with Webhooks.Verify, acknowledge it quickly, and handle its event in a queue worker.
- [.NET push notifications quickstart](dotnet/quickstarts/push.md): Send push notifications for ConvoHop messages and calls: PushPayloads turns notification events into APNs, FCM and Web Push requests, and you send them with your own push credentials and libraries.
- [.NET reference](dotnet/reference/index.md): The public API of each .NET package, generated from its declarations.
- [ConvoHop](dotnet/reference/convohop.md): Server SDK for trusted .NET backends: project and management clients for backend-key calls, typed errors, recovery storage, webhook verification and push payload builders.
- [ConvoHop.Api](dotnet/reference/api.md): Generated APIs with a method for every communication and management operation a backend can send, and async page streams for paginated ones.
- [ConvoHop.Models](dotnet/reference/models.md): Generated input and result models of the ConvoHop GraphQL API.
- [.NET operation coverage](dotnet/reference/operations.md): The .NET SDK members that send each API operation. 65 of the 81 operations that .NET packages can send have a method.

## Java and Kotlin

- [Java and Kotlin SDKs](jvm/index.md): com.convohop:convohop-server wraps the ConvoHop API for Java backends, and com.convohop:convohop-server-kotlin adds coroutine extensions to it. Both run only in your backend, with a secret backend key. Never put them, or the key, in an Android app or any other client.
- [Java and Kotlin server quickstart](jvm/quickstarts/server.md): Call ConvoHop from your Java or Kotlin backend with convohop-server: connect with a backend key, sign in your users, create a conversation, send and read messages as a member, recover a send whose response was lost, and make the calls from coroutines.
- [Java and Kotlin webhooks quickstart](jvm/quickstarts/webhooks.md): Receive ConvoHop events in your Java or Kotlin backend with convohop-server: verify each signed delivery, acknowledge it quickly, and handle its event in a queue worker.
- [Java and Kotlin push notifications quickstart](jvm/quickstarts/push.md): Send push notifications for ConvoHop messages and calls: convohop-server turns notification events into APNs, FCM and Web Push requests, and you send them with your own push credentials and libraries.
- [Java and Kotlin reference](jvm/reference/index.md): The public API of each Java and Kotlin package, generated from its declarations.
- [com.convohop:convohop-server](jvm/reference/server.md): Java server SDK for trusted JVM backends: backend-key data-plane calls, management, webhook verification and push requests.
- [com.convohop:convohop-server-kotlin](jvm/reference/server-kotlin.md): Kotlin coroutine extensions for the Java server SDK: suspending APIs, page flows and interruptible blocking calls.
- [Java and Kotlin operation coverage](jvm/reference/operations.md): The Java and Kotlin SDK members that send each API operation. 65 of the 81 operations that Java and Kotlin packages can send have a method.

## Go

- [Go SDK](go/index.md): github.com/ConvoHop/sdks/go wraps the ConvoHop API for Go backends. It runs only in your backend, with a secret backend key, verifies the webhooks that ConvoHop sends, and builds push requests from notification events.
- [Go server quickstart](go/quickstarts/server.md): Call ConvoHop from your Go backend with github.com/ConvoHop/sdks/go: connect with a backend key, sign in your users, create a conversation, send and read messages as a member, and recover a send whose response was lost.
- [Go webhooks quickstart](go/quickstarts/webhooks.md): Receive ConvoHop events in your Go backend with the webhooks package: verify each signed delivery, acknowledge it quickly, and handle its event in a queue worker.
- [Go push notifications quickstart](go/quickstarts/push.md): Send push notifications for ConvoHop messages and calls: the push package turns notification events into APNs, FCM and Web Push requests, and you send them with your own push credentials and clients.
- [Go reference](go/reference/index.md): The public API of each Go package, generated from its declarations.
- [github.com/ConvoHop/sdks/go](go/reference/convohop.md): Server SDK for trusted Go backends: backend-key data-plane calls and operator management calls, with typed problems, request retries and recovery storage.
- [github.com/ConvoHop/sdks/go/webhooks](go/reference/webhooks.md): Verifies Standard Webhooks signatures and parses ConvoHop webhook deliveries into typed events.
- [github.com/ConvoHop/sdks/go/push](go/reference/push.md): Builds APNs, FCM and Web Push requests from ConvoHop push notification events.
- [Go operation coverage](go/reference/operations.md): The Go SDK members that send each API operation. 65 of the 81 operations that Go packages can send have a method.

## Swift

- [Swift SDK](swift/index.md): ConvoHop is the Swift SDK for iOS and macOS apps. It acts as one user, with a short-lived session that your backend issues, and covers chat with a local store, an offline outbox and optimistic sends, typing signals and read receipts, calls through the LiveKit Swift SDK, and APNs push notifications, with incoming calls that ring through PushKit and CallKit on iOS. It never holds a backend key.
- [Swift client quickstart](swift/quickstarts/client.md): Use ConvoHop in your iOS or macOS app with the ConvoHop Swift package: connect with the session your backend issued and keep it renewed, show a conversation from a local store and keep it current, and send messages optimistically through an outbox that survives dropped connections and restarts.
- [Swift push notifications quickstart](swift/quickstarts/push.md): Show ConvoHop's push notifications in your iOS or macOS app with the ConvoHop Swift package: register the device with APNs, open the conversation or call that a notification is about, and show message text from a Notification Service Extension whether or not the project sends message previews.
- [Swift calling quickstart](swift/quickstarts/calling.md): Add voice and video calls to a conversation with the ConvoHop Swift package and the official LiveKit Swift SDK: start a call and ring other members, join the current call, answer incoming calls through CallKit, and leave or end a call.
- [Swift reference](swift/reference/index.md): The public API of each Swift package, generated from its declarations.
- [ConvoHop](swift/reference/convohop.md): Client SDK for apps on end-user devices: one signed-in user's conversations, realtime events with replay, the local store, the offline outbox, read receipts, typing, recent activity, call control and push routing. It re-exports ConvoHopPush.
- [ConvoHopLiveKit](swift/reference/livekit.md): Call media through the official LiveKit Swift SDK, and CallKit audio session handling on iOS.
- [ConvoHopPush](swift/reference/push.md): Push payload parsing, deduplication, the ring ledger and the push recipient, with Foundation only so app extensions can use it.
- [ConvoHopCalls](swift/reference/calls.md): Incoming calls from PushKit VoIP pushes to CallKit, and outgoing calls through CallKit.
- [ConvoHopNotificationService](swift/reference/notification-service.md): A Notification Service Extension helper that fetches message text on the device when a push has none, and hides the text of other users' pushes.
- [Swift operation coverage](swift/reference/operations.md): The Swift SDK members that send each API operation. 32 of the 35 operations that Swift packages can send have a method.

## Android

- [Android SDK](android/index.md): com.convohop:convohop-android is the Kotlin SDK for Android apps. It acts as one user, with a short-lived session that your backend issues, and covers chat with a local store, an offline outbox and optimistic sends, typing signals and read receipts, calls through the LiveKit Android SDK, and FCM push notifications that ring incoming calls through Telecom. It never holds a backend key.
- [Android client quickstart](android/quickstarts/client.md): Use ConvoHop in your Android app with com.convohop:convohop-android: connect with the session your backend issued and keep it renewed, show a conversation from a local store and keep it current, and send messages optimistically through an outbox that survives dropped connections and restarts.
- [Android push notifications quickstart](android/quickstarts/push.md): Show ConvoHop's push notifications in your Android app with com.convohop:convohop-android: register the device with Firebase Cloud Messaging, show message notifications whether or not the project sends message previews, and ring incoming calls.
- [Android calling quickstart](android/quickstarts/calling.md): Add voice and video calls to a conversation with com.convohop:convohop-android: start a call and ring other members, join the current call, answer incoming calls from a push, and leave or end a call.
- [Android reference](android/reference/index.md): The public API of each Android package, generated from its declarations.
- [com.convohop:convohop-android](android/reference/android.md): The SDK an Android app depends on: SQLite and SharedPreferences storage, network monitoring, LiveKit calls and message text for notifications. It brings in the other two packages.
- [com.convohop:convohop-android-core](android/reference/android-core.md): The platform-free client that convohop-android brings in: sessions and their renewal, conversations, the store, the offline outbox, timelines, recovery, live sessions and the generated protocol types.
- [com.convohop:convohop-android-push](android/reference/android-push.md): FCM registration, notifications and Telecom incoming calls, with no networking, LiveKit or coroutines, so a React Native or Flutter wrapper can ship it alone.
- [Android operation coverage](android/reference/operations.md): The Android SDK members that send each API operation. 32 of the 35 operations that Android packages can send have a method.

## Flutter

- [Flutter SDK](flutter/index.md): convohop is the ConvoHop client SDK for Flutter apps on Android and iOS. It runs one signed-in user's session in your app: conversations and their realtime events, a local conversation store, an offline outbox with optimistic sends, read receipts, typing, recent activity, calls through the official livekit_client package, push registration and the system incoming-call UI.
- [Flutter client quickstart](flutter/quickstarts/client.md): Use ConvoHop in your users' Flutter apps with package:convohop: connect with the session your backend issued, show a conversation and keep it current, and send messages that survive dropped connections and app restarts.
- [Flutter push notifications quickstart](flutter/quickstarts/push.md): Show ConvoHop push notifications in your users' Flutter apps with package:convohop/push.dart: register the device for FCM or APNs, open conversations from notifications, and ring for calls with the system call UI.
- [Flutter calling quickstart](flutter/quickstarts/calling.md): Add voice and video calls to a conversation with package:convohop: start a call and ring other members, join the current call, and leave or end it.
- [Flutter reference](flutter/reference/index.md): The public API of each Flutter package, generated from its declarations.
- [package:convohop/convohop.dart](flutter/reference/convohop.md): Client SDK for Flutter apps on end-user devices: one signed-in user's conversations, realtime events, conversation store, offline outbox, read receipts, typing, recent activity and call control.
- [package:convohop/calls.dart](flutter/reference/calls.md): Call media through the official livekit_client package.
- [package:convohop/push.dart](flutter/reference/push.md): Push registration, notification payloads and the system incoming-call UI, through the package's own platform code.
- [package:convohop/io.dart](flutter/reference/io.md): File-backed recovery storage for the conversation store and the outbox.
- [Flutter operation coverage](flutter/reference/operations.md): The Flutter SDK members that send each API operation. 35 of the 35 operations that Flutter packages can send have a method.

## API operations

- [API operations](operations/index.md): Every operation in the ConvoHop GraphQL API, with its authorization, idempotency, input, result and errors, and the SDK members that send it.
- [communication.capabilities](operations/communication/capabilities.md): Describe the features, limits and API model the authority supports.
- [communication.route](operations/communication/route.md): Return the signed route: project incarnation, serving epoch and realtime endpoint. Call it before other communication operations and again after WRONG_REGION.
- [communication.currentSession](operations/communication/currentSession.md): Return the calling user session.
- [communication.getPrincipal](operations/communication/getPrincipal.md): Read a principal (an application user).
- [communication.getConversation](operations/communication/getConversation.md): Read a conversation.
- [communication.members](operations/communication/members.md): List the members of a conversation.
- [communication.messages](operations/communication/messages.md): List the messages of a conversation, newest first. A backend key reads the full history, or the history visible to the member named by actAsPrincipalId.
- [communication.getMessage](operations/communication/getMessage.md): Read one message. A backend key reads any message, or reads as the member named by actAsPrincipalId.
- [communication.events](operations/communication/events.md): Replay committed conversation events after a cursor, in sequence order.
- [communication.receipts](operations/communication/receipts.md): List the delivery and read receipts of a conversation.
- [communication.inbox](operations/communication/inbox.md): List the conversations visible to the calling user. A backend key must name that user with actAsPrincipalId.
- [communication.search](operations/communication/search.md): Search the messages visible to the calling user. A backend key searches as the member named by actAsPrincipalId, or within scope.conversationIds.
- [communication.resolveRequest](operations/communication/resolveRequest.md): Look up the stored outcome of an earlier communication mutation by its requestId.
- [communication.getOperation](operations/communication/getOperation.md): Read the state of a long-running communication operation.
- [communication.conversationMute](operations/communication/conversationMute.md): Read whether a member has muted message push notifications for a conversation. A backend key must name the member with actAsPrincipalId.
- [communication.currentLiveSession](operations/communication/currentLiveSession.md): Return the active live session of a conversation, if any.
- [communication.liveSession](operations/communication/liveSession.md): Read a live session.
- [communication.liveSessions](operations/communication/liveSessions.md): List the live sessions of a conversation.
- [communication.liveSessionParticipants](operations/communication/liveSessionParticipants.md): List the participants of a live session.
- [communication.liveSessionAlerts](operations/communication/liveSessionAlerts.md): List the live session alerts addressed to the calling user.
- [communication.liveSessionOperation](operations/communication/liveSessionOperation.md): Read the state of a live session start or end operation.
- [communication.sessionRequestOutcome](operations/communication/sessionRequestOutcome.md): Look up the outcome of an earlier issueSession or renewSession request, including the session it produced.
- [communication.createPrincipal](operations/communication/createPrincipal.md): Create a principal for an application user.
- [communication.disablePrincipal](operations/communication/disablePrincipal.md): Disable a principal.
- [communication.issueSession](operations/communication/issueSession.md): Issue a short-lived user session token for a principal and device.
- [communication.renewSession](operations/communication/renewSession.md): Renew a user session before it expires.
- [communication.revokeSession](operations/communication/revokeSession.md): Revoke a user session.
- [communication.createConversation](operations/communication/createConversation.md): Create a conversation with its initial members.
- [communication.updateConversation](operations/communication/updateConversation.md): Update the title or properties of a conversation.
- [communication.addMember](operations/communication/addMember.md): Add a member, or change the role of an active member.
- [communication.addMembers](operations/communication/addMembers.md): Add several members in one request.
- [communication.removeMember](operations/communication/removeMember.md): Remove a member from a conversation.
- [communication.historyGrant](operations/communication/historyGrant.md): Expand the history a member can see to an earlier sequence.
- [communication.sendMessage](operations/communication/sendMessage.md): Send a message. A backend key sends as its service principal, or as the member named by actAsPrincipalId.
- [communication.editMessage](operations/communication/editMessage.md): Edit a message.
- [communication.deleteMessage](operations/communication/deleteMessage.md): Delete a message.
- [communication.reportReceipt](operations/communication/reportReceipt.md): Report delivery or read progress through a sequence.
- [communication.typing](operations/communication/typing.md): Send an ephemeral typing signal.
- [communication.setBroadcastPermission](operations/communication/setBroadcastPermission.md): Allow or deny a member to publish media in live sessions.
- [communication.setConversationMute](operations/communication/setConversationMute.md): Mute or unmute message push notifications for a member of a conversation, optionally until a time. Calls still ring. A backend key must name the member with actAsPrincipalId.
- [communication.startLiveSession](operations/communication/startLiveSession.md): Start a live session (a call) in a conversation. Readiness completes asynchronously.
- [communication.joinLiveSession](operations/communication/joinLiveSession.md): Join a live session.
- [communication.alertLiveSession](operations/communication/alertLiveSession.md): Alert (ring) conversation members about a live session.
- [communication.leaveLiveSession](operations/communication/leaveLiveSession.md): Leave a live session.
- [communication.endLiveSession](operations/communication/endLiveSession.md): End a live session for every participant. Completes asynchronously.
- [communication.liveSessionCredentials](operations/communication/liveSessionCredentials.md): Obtain a media credential for one connection of the caller's participation.
- [communication.redeemCredential](operations/communication/redeemCredential.md): Redeem a delivered credential with its delivery permit.
- [communication.acknowledgeCredential](operations/communication/acknowledgeCredential.md): Acknowledge that a redeemed credential is stored, closing the delivery.
- [communication.conversationEvents](operations/communication/conversationEvents.md): Subscribe to conversation events in sequence order, resuming after a cursor.
- [management.capabilities](operations/management/capabilities.md): Describe the management features and limits the authority supports.
- [management.organizations](operations/management/organizations.md): List the organizations the caller can access.
- [management.getOrganization](operations/management/getOrganization.md): Read an organization.
- [management.getDeployment](operations/management/getDeployment.md): Read a deployment.
- [management.getProject](operations/management/getProject.md): Read a project.
- [management.deploymentHealth](operations/management/deploymentHealth.md): Read the health of a deployment.
- [management.deploymentUsage](operations/management/deploymentUsage.md): Read the metered usage of a deployment, summed over its projects. The range defaults to the current UTC month to date, both bounds round up to whole UTC hours, and it spans at most 400 days.
- [management.projectUsage](operations/management/projectUsage.md): Read the metered usage of a project. The range defaults to the current UTC month to date, both bounds round up to whole UTC hours, and it spans at most 400 days.
- [management.organizationUsage](operations/management/organizationUsage.md): Read the metered usage of an organization in any status, summed over its projects. The range defaults to the current UTC month to date, both bounds round up to whole UTC hours, and it spans at most 400 days.
- [management.organizationBilling](operations/management/organizationBilling.md): Read the billing state of an organization in any status: the plan whose limits apply, whether ConvoHop bills the organization and, when it does, its standing and subscription.
- [management.webhookEndpoints](operations/management/webhookEndpoints.md): List the webhook endpoints of a project with their status, signing-secret rotation and delivery health.
- [management.webhookDeliveries](operations/management/webhookDeliveries.md): List recent deliveries of a webhook endpoint.
- [management.resolveRequest](operations/management/resolveRequest.md): Look up the stored outcome of an earlier management mutation by its requestId.
- [management.getOperation](operations/management/getOperation.md): Read the state of a long-running management operation.
- [management.agentSignupForApproval](operations/management/agentSignupForApproval.md): Read a pending agent signup request for its approval page, with the agent's suggested plan, scopes and monthly spend cap.
- [management.agentSignup](operations/management/agentSignup.md): Read the agent's own signup: its state and, once approved, the organization, project, grant scopes and expiry, and keys. Poll no more often than the ticket's pollAfterSeconds.
- [management.agentGrants](operations/management/agentGrants.md): List an organization's agent grants with their keys, newest first.
- [management.agentAuditEvents](operations/management/agentAuditEvents.md): List an organization's agent audit trail, newest first: the approval, provisioning, keys, revocations, spend-control changes and purchases.
- [management.organizationSpend](operations/management/organizationSpend.md): Read the organization's spend this month: its cap, credits, minimum credit, charge limit, charges, margin, spend stop and the freshness of its usage.
- [management.createOrganization](operations/management/createOrganization.md): Create an organization.
- [management.createDeployment](operations/management/createDeployment.md): Create a deployment in an organization. Completes asynchronously.
- [management.createProject](operations/management/createProject.md): Create a project in a ready deployment. Completes asynchronously.
- [management.issueBackendKey](operations/management/issueBackendKey.md): Issue a scoped backend key. The secret is delivered once through a credential delivery.
- [management.revokeBackendKey](operations/management/revokeBackendKey.md): Revoke a backend key, optionally revoking the sessions it issued.
- [management.projectPolicy](operations/management/projectPolicy.md): Change the policy of a project.
- [management.credentialPermit](operations/management/credentialPermit.md): Issue a signed permit that authorizes redeeming one credential delivery.
- [management.pauseOperation](operations/management/pauseOperation.md): Pause a long-running operation.
- [management.resumeOperation](operations/management/resumeOperation.md): Resume a paused operation.
- [management.createBillingCheckoutSession](operations/management/createBillingCheckoutSession.md): Create a hosted checkout link that subscribes an active organization to a self-service plan. The link grants access to whoever holds it; a retry with the same requestId returns the same link until it expires.
- [management.createBillingPortalSession](operations/management/createBillingPortalSession.md): Create a hosted billing portal link where an organization manages its payment methods, invoices and subscription. The link grants access to whoever holds it; a retry with the same requestId returns the same link until it expires.
- [management.configureWebhook](operations/management/configureWebhook.md): Create a webhook endpoint for project events. The signing secret is delivered once through a credential delivery.
- [management.updateWebhook](operations/management/updateWebhook.md): Change the event types of a webhook endpoint, or enable or disable it.
- [management.rotateWebhookSecret](operations/management/rotateWebhookSecret.md): Start rotating the signing secret of a webhook endpoint. The next secret is delivered once through a credential delivery.
- [management.disableWebhook](operations/management/disableWebhook.md): Disable a webhook endpoint.
- [management.replayWebhookDeliveries](operations/management/replayWebhookDeliveries.md): Redeliver one webhook delivery, or the deliveries of an endpoint in a time range, with their original event IDs.
- [management.requestAgentSignup](operations/management/requestAgentSignup.md): Request an organization for a named human owner, who approves it from an emailed link. Nothing is usable before approval.
- [management.rejectAgentSignup](operations/management/rejectAgentSignup.md): Reject a signup request from its approval link, optionally suppressing future requests to the email.
- [management.approveAgentSignup](operations/management/approveAgentSignup.md): Approve a signup request with its approval token and the agent's confirmation code, choosing the plan, scopes, monthly spend cap, agent purchase limit and grant expiry. The signed-in approver becomes the owner.
- [management.issueAgentKey](operations/management/issueAgentKey.md): Issue a backend key for the agent within its grant's scopes and expiry. The result is the pending key; poll agentSignup until it shows the key's delivery, then redeem it with agentCredentialPermit.
- [management.agentCredentialPermit](operations/management/agentCredentialPermit.md): Issue a permit that authorizes the agent to redeem one of its key deliveries.
- [management.revokeAgentGrant](operations/management/revokeAgentGrant.md): Revoke an agent grant and every key issued under it.
- [management.setSpendControls](operations/management/setSpendControls.md): Set the organization's monthly spend cap and agent purchase limit.
- [management.purchaseAgentCredits](operations/management/purchaseAgentCredits.md): Buy prepaid credits with a Shared Payment Token, within the owner's agent purchase limit.
